title: Common Bug Category 71
why_it_happens: Improper boundary initialization or missing increments.
explanation: Ensure pointer bounds do not exceed bounds of the collection.
corrected_example:
def solution(arr):
    return arr[len(arr)-1] if arr else None
content:
Mistake Type: off-by-one
Symptoms: IndexError or infinite loop behavior.
Why it happens: Improper boundary initialization or missing increments.
Explanation: Ensure pointer bounds do not exceed bounds of the collection.
Bad Example:
def solution(arr):
    return arr[len(arr)]
Corrected Example:
def solution(arr):
    return arr[len(arr)-1] if arr else None
hint: Check the upper index of your loop.
complexity_impact: Degrades performance from O(N) to O(N^2) or crashes the program.
